en: Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*araṇa*) and has the Path as its object, there arises a state that is not a refuge (*nasaraṇa*) and does not have the Path as its object, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and has the Path as its cause (*maggahetuka*), there arises a state that is not a refuge and does not have the Path as its cause, by way of root-condition. Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and has the Path as its predominance (*adhipati*), there arises a state that is not a refuge and does not have the Path as its predominance, by way of root-condition. Under root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], one.
